title: The 6 best grammar checkers in 2027
summary: We tested the best grammar checkers and rewording tools to find the ones that actually make your writing shine. Here are the best ones.
body_markdown:

[Grammarly](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#grammarly)


All-around editing


Plagiarism checker


Free plan available; paid plans from $12/user/month


[Wordtune](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#wordtune)


Rewriting, shortening, and expanding content


Feature for adding analogies, counterarguments, facts, and more


Free plan available; paid plans from $6.99/month (billed annually)


[ProWritingAid](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#prowritingaid)


Creative writing


Custom style guide without a team upgrade


Free plan available; paid plans from $10/month


[LanguageTool](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#languagetool)


Multilingual writers


Auto-detects language and switches accordingly


Free plan available; paid plans from $5.83/month (billed annually)


[Hemingway Editor](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#hemingway)


Writing stats


Real-time writing stats and readability/grade level tracking


Free for editing on the web only; paid plan for $19.99 (one-time purchase)


[Paperpal](https://zapier.com/blog/best-ai-grammar-checker-rewording-tool/#paperpal)


Academic writing


Subject-specific language suggestions for academic work


Free plan available; paid plans from $7.20/month (billed annually)
